
DESCRIPTION
Refresh continuous-integration configuration

USAGE
  one ci sync [project] [flags]

EXAMPLES
  one ci sync
  one ci sync web

TIPS
Regenerates configuration for one enabled project, or every project that already has continuous integration enabled.

COMMON OPTIONS
  -o, --output <value>     Output format: json | yaml | text (default: terminal-friendly text, JSON when piped)

AUTOMATION AND ADVANCED OPTIONS
  -p, --project <value>    Select a project by name or workspace-relative path (legacy/automation)
